patchNote: Based on {id}; only the differences are stored.
patchNoteNamed: Based on {id} ({name}); only the differences are stored.
loadingParent: Loading the rule set it is based on…

items.intro: Everything that becomes a line in the BoQ: from the model (elements measured), calculated from other items (formwork, paint, reinforcement estimates) and entered by hand (preliminaries, sums). Settings answers point into these; change an item here only when no answer covers what you need.

model.title: From the model
model.hint: Takes model elements and measures them into BoQ lines.

calculated.title: Calculated from other items
calculated.hint: Work that is not modelled (formwork, paint, reinforcement estimates), calculated from the lines or elements of other items.

manual.title: Entered by hand
manual.hint: Lines with no model behind them: preliminaries, provisional sums, lump sums, dayworks. No quantity = a flagged line for the user to fill.

items.selectOne: Select an item on the left, or add one.
items.inheritedNote: Inherited unchanged from the rule set this one is based on.
items.removedNote: The rule set this one is based on has this item; this set leaves it out.
items.changedNote: Changed in this set; replaces the inherited version.

story.dedSum: minus all {what} when together they exceed {size}
story.noWay: “{name}”, which has no way of measuring
story.extraOut: only elements left out of this BoQ
story.switchOn: In the BoQ: switched by Settings {slot} (now yes).
story.switchOff: Not in the BoQ: switched by Settings {slot} (now no).
story.switchedOff: Switched off: not in the BoQ.
story.linesSource: one line for each source line
story.item: <how>{kind, select, count {Count} formula {Calculate} when {Measure} choose {Measure} other {Measure the {qty} of}}</how> {kind, select, formula {for each of the } other {}}<whatSeg>{what}</whatSeg>{hasAfter, select, yes {<how>{after}</how>} other {}}{hasDed, select, yes {, <how>{deductions}</how>} other {}}, <linesSeg>{lines}</linesSeg>, written as <text></text>.
story.derived: For each <whatSeg>{scope, select, line {line} other {element}} of {from}{hasWhere, select, yes { where {where}} other {}}</whatSeg>, calculate <how>{formula} {unit}</how>, <linesSeg>{lines}</linesSeg>, written as <text></text>.
story.manual: A line with no model behind it (<name>{kind}</name>), written as <text></text>, with <how>{qty}</how> {unit}{hasAmount, select, yes {, amount {amount}} other {}}.
story.leftToFill: a quantity left for you to fill in

parts.kindsHint: Pick one or more kinds of element.
parts.kindsHintCounts: Numbers are how many the loaded model has.
parts.nothingPicked: Nothing picked: this item takes no elements.
parts.noKindPicked: No kind picked: any element that meets the conditions below.
parts.narrowHint: Optional. “Is a kind of” uses the dictionary: material is a kind of concrete also takes “concrete.in_situ”.
parts.unitHint: Empty: the usual unit (nr, m, m2, m3, kg).
parts.whichAnswerHint: Usually a Settings question with a choice of answers; each answer gets its own way of measuring below.
parts.ifHint: A condition on the element, e.g. [Thickness] >= 0.25: then measure one way, otherwise the other.
parts.noDeductions: Nothing is taken out: openings, doors and windows stay in the quantity.
parts.recessesNote: Recesses: openings the model marks as recesses. Deducted as their face area, or area x recess depth for volumes; never part of “openings”.
parts.embeddedNote: Columns and beams passing through (rooms: columns standing in them), as the area they take, or that area x thickness for volumes.

questions.none: This rule set has no questions yet. Add them under Advanced › Questions setup, with a section and a question, and they appear here.
questions.introPatch: Answer the questions as your rulebook does. Anything you leave keeps the answer from {id}. Only your differing answers are stored.
questions.introPatchNamed: Answer the questions as your rulebook does. Anything you leave keeps the answer from {id} ({name}). Only your differing answers are stored.
questions.introStandalone: These are the questions this rule set asks. Their values here are the defaults every set based on it starts from.
questions.otherSettingsIntro: Questions not yet placed in a section.
questions.followUps: {n, plural, one {# follow-up question} other {# follow-up questions}} for other answers
questions.openItem: Open the item that uses this answer
questions.notUsed: Not used by any item yet
questions.missing: Missing a question your rulebook answers? <add>Add one</add> under Advanced › Questions setup and point an item at it, or change the item itself under BoQ items.

setup.intro: Set up the questions of the Settings tab: wording, type, answers, follow-ups, and which section they are in. Items use a question's answer through the “setting” button on a field.
setup.selectOne: Select a question on the left, or add one.
setup.nameInvalid: Letters, digits and _ only, not starting with a digit.
setup.deleteConfirm: “{question}” is used by {items}. Those items will report a missing value. Delete anyway?
setup.wordedByParent: Worded by the rule set this one is based on ({parent}); only the answer can change here.
setup.changeHere: Change the question in this set
setup.changedHere: Changed in this set; replaces the inherited version.
setup.question: Question
setup.questionPlaceholder: As the rulebook would answer it
setup.shortNameHint: Shown in tables, in formulas ([Short name]) and next to fields that use it.
setup.storedAsInherited: Inherited name; it cannot change in this set.
setup.storedAsHint: Renaming updates every item and formula in this set that uses it.
setup.exampleHint: A worked example, shown folded under the question.
setup.onlyAskWhenHint: A follow-up question: shown under the question it depends on, and only for these answers.
setup.notUsed: No item uses this answer yet. Point a field of an item at it with its “setting” button.
setup.answersHint: Each answer has a stored name (what items and follow-ups refer to) and the text people see.
setup.answersNote: Items that choose a way of measuring by this answer (“Let a Settings answer choose”) need one option per answer. Renaming an answer here renames it there too, and in follow-up questions and formulas.
setup.formulaHint: The formula is the answer. Ready-made formulas are offered as a pick list in Settings.
setup.variablesHint: In words, shown under the answer, e.g. “The footing: length, width, height”.
setup.addReadyMade: + Add the current answer as a ready-made formula
setup.sections: Sections ({n}): the groups and order of the Settings tab
setup.removeSectionConfirm: {n, plural, one {# question is} other {# questions are}} in “{title}”. They move to “Other settings”. Remove the section?
setup.sectionsPatchNote: The inherited sections keep their order; a new title here replaces the inherited one, and new sections come after them.

forms.name: Name
forms.stepWhatHint: Pick the kinds of element, then narrow them down if you need to.
forms.stepLinesHint: Elements with the same values are added up into one line.
forms.takesHint: Elements left out of this BoQ (Advanced › About and defaults, “Left out of this BoQ”) are only for items that take them, e.g. demolition.

scopes.out: only elements left out of it

forms.partsHint: Stair flights, roof slabs… are skipped when their parent is measured, unless included.
forms.bandsHint: Separate lines for ranges of a value, e.g. work above 3.5 m height. Edges are numbers or p.slot.
forms.tagsHint: Classification maps can match on tags.
forms.claimsHint: Two items claiming the same name on one element raise a double-count question.
forms.idHint: Renaming updates the calculated items of this set that use it; classifications that name it need the new id too.
forms.onePerHint: Nothing ticked and nothing below: all of them in one line.
forms.alsoSplitHint: Any other value or a formula. IF(p.lines_by_storey, storey, "") splits by storey only when that Settings answer is yes.
forms.lineTextHint: A name in '{'curly brackets'}' is replaced by each line's own value.
forms.stepFromHint: Work that is not modelled (formwork, paint, reinforcement estimates), worked out from the lines or elements of other items.

derivedScopes.element: each of their elements (uses its measured values)

forms.onlyWhereHint: Optional: skip the lines or elements this is false for.

grouping.source: one for each line it comes from

forms.derivedSplitHint: Values of the lines or elements it comes from.
forms.manualQuantityHint: Leave the quantity and the formula empty to get a line for you to fill in.
forms.orFormula: Or a formula (answers and building values)
forms.amountHint: Money value for provisional and lump sums.
forms.starterTitle: New item measured from the model
forms.starterIntro: What do you want in the BoQ? Pick a kind of element. It starts measured the usual way, one line per type; you can change everything after.
forms.starterCopy: Or start from a copy of an item that is close to what you want:

about.name: Name
about.idHint: The rule set's id inside the document; sets based on this one refer to it.
about.extendsHint: Fixed by the version this set was created on.
about.aboutPatchHint: Empty fields are taken from the rule set this one is based on.
about.basedOnHint: Free text, e.g. “our reading of NRM2”. Never a compliance claim.
about.author: Author
about.leftOutHint: Elements matching any of these are not measured and not asked about (the log counts them). Items set to measure “only elements left out” take exactly these, e.g. demolition.
about.asParent: As the rule set this one is based on decides.
about.defaultsHint: Apply to every rule that does not set its own.
